fields.label: Stock locations
fields.description: Where the board reads stock. Bulk stock is counted in every warehouse listed under Bulk Warehouses.

fields.label: Bulk Warehouses
fields.description: Bulk (BIP) stock is available for filling wherever it sits in these warehouses.

fields.label: Colourant Warehouse
fields.description: Where Is Colourant items are stocked.

fields.label: Raw Material Warehouses
fields.description: Free stock for raw materials and packaging is summed across these.

fields.label: Cook Target Warehouse
fields.description: Target for Work Orders created from a bulk card, unless the item has its own Default Warehouse.

fields.label: Fill & Tint Target Warehouse
fields.description: Target for fill and tint Work Orders created from the board.

fields.label: Count Confirmed Orders From Last (Days)
fields.description: The board's default date window: orders confirmed in the last this-many days. Older undelivered orders are counted in the banner and can be added with the date choices on the page.

fields.label: Draft Workflow States
fields.description: Sales Order workflow states shown in Drafts (forecast) mode.

fields.label: Work Orders
fields.description: What open Work Orders will make, and the materials they still need, are counted only when Include Work Orders is ticked.

fields.label: Include Work Orders
fields.description: Ticked: open Work Orders count as stock on the way, and only the materials THEY still need are set aside. Unticked: Work Orders play no part in the plan and are not shown on the cards; free stock is the stock on the shelf.

fields.label: Deduct Work Orders Planned In Last (Days)
fields.description: Older open Work Orders are treated as abandoned: not deducted and nothing set aside for them; they are flagged on the Pending tab. Stopped Work Orders are never deducted.

fields.label: Include Purchase Orders
fields.description: Ticked: quantities on open Purchase Orders count as incoming and are shown on the material cards. Unticked: shortfall = requirement minus free stock. Untick while received Purchase Orders are not being closed.

fields.label: Price for Shortfall Value
fields.description: Price used to value a material shortfall. Falls back to the other price when the chosen one is missing.

fields.label: Pending Work Orders & Purchase Orders tab
Flag Documents With No Progress For (Days)
fields.description: A Work Order with no progress, or a Purchase Order overdue or not received, for longer than this is flagged on the Pending tab.

fields.label: Excess Fill Rule
fields.options:
Lowest stock cover first
Smallest pack first
Largest pack first
fields.description: How top-up bulk from a minimum batch is shared across monitored pack sizes.

fields.label: Tint Base Priority
fields.options:
Urgent then oldest across all orders
Direct base orders first
fields.default: Urgent then oldest across all orders
fields.description: Who gets packed-base stock first: tint orders or direct orders for the base.

fields.label: Show Shelf Refills Without Orders
fields.description: Monitored fast movers below their Minimum Reorder Level appear even when no order is open.

fields.label: BOM Mass Balance Tolerance
fields.description: Bulk BOMs whose ingredients differ from output by more than this (after process loss) are listed in Needs Setup.

fields.label: Fallback Refresh (Minutes)
fields.description: Live events refresh the board sooner. This is the safety net.

fields.label: Calculation Engine
fields.description: The shared secret is read from site_config.json (crystal_api_internal_secret), never stored here.

fields.label: Test Connection
fields.description: Checks the Engine URL and the shared secret.

fields.label: Preview Board
fields.description: Runs a fresh calculation on today's real data and shows a summary.

fields.label: Download Snapshot
fields.description: System Manager only: the exact data sent to the engine, as a file.

fields.label: Auto-replace Sub-BOM Links
fields.description: When a BOM becomes the default for its item, re-point every parent BOM still using an older version (via ERPNext's BOM Update Tool).

fields.label: Allowed Roles
fields.description: Roles that can open the production board. System Manager always can.
